acceptanceCriteria.criterion: private network default deny、approval bypass=0、未授权外传=0
evidence: 02b-electron-real.txt: 5/5 private targets refused with reason private-network-default-deny (loopback, link-local metadata, rfc1918, ipv6 loopback)
01-guard-unit.txt: 32 unit assertions incl. default deny, bounded approval, forged-localhost refused
08-navigation-guard-wired.txt: guard wired in the host call path, default-deny literal present
approveBrowserPrivateNetwork has no route/registry reference (grep: 1 hit = its own definition), so no model-facing approval bypass exists

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: 取消/超时/重启后无孤儿 session
evidence: 01-guard-unit.txt: closeAllAgentBrowserSessions closes every listed session through the same owner, reports stuck sessions, survives a throwing list(), and drops the resource-envelope entry
02b-electron-real.txt: shutdown reaper registered in the real Main process (will-quit listener count > 0)

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: 模型能正确说明 Browser 需要 supervised 权限
evidence: 02b-electron-real.txt: status returns capabilities.supervision=required with 19 supervised actions; click/type/evaluate/navigate/uploadFiles are supervised

residualLimitations: The workspace-preview first-party exception allows loopback origins that the host itself persisted in workspace state; metadata and RFC1918 ranges can never ride that exception.
The reaper closes sessions on the Electron will-quit lifecycle; a hard process kill (SIGKILL / power loss) cannot run it.
The public-navigation case only proves the private-network guard is not what refuses it; a real page load is covered by the existing browser E2E suites, not asserted here.
